title: A Letter to the Mountain

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a letter

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Sheep, wool, honey and apples! What an autumn fortnight.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Mr. Silas will be alone on the mountain soon, when the snow comes. Would you write him a letter to keep him company?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Write the letter: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: I hope you stay {wish} this winter.
Thank you for this autumn on the mountain.
When the snow comes, I hope you {wish}.
Please walk down to the valley for {event}.

feedback.all_good: A kind letter. It will keep him warm on a cold night.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Off it goes, up the mountain road. A letter is a little bit of company you can keep in your pocket.

journal_line: I wrote a letter to Mr. Silas on the mountain.
